Capabilities

What you get with Live AI Multilingual Subtitles

01 99+% accurate

AI converts the live stream audio to lines of text

Our leading Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) technology generates 99+% accurate captions. It supports any language, including streams where multiple languages are spoken.

02 100% accurate

Enhance captions with real-time editing and vocabularies

Users can optionally edit the AI-generated captions in real time, before they are translated and streamed. Custom vocabularies improve recognition and accuracy of specific terms.

03 99.9+% accurate

AI translates the captions into any number of languages

Top-tier AI language models let you add closed captions in multiple languages cost-effectively. With an accurate source, expect top-notch translation quality.

04

Perfect synchronisation of captions and video

Captions are aligned again with the spoken words so they appear at the right time and stay on screen long enough for viewers to follow the narrative.

05

Contextual AI technology

By slightly increasing HLS latency, SabioCast sends more context to the ASR and translation engines. This results in significantly greater accuracy for automatically generated and translated captions.

06

Best-in-class language models

We benchmark different AI solutions so SabioCast can automatically select the best engine on the market when a live stream is configured.

Web interface to edit incoming captions and update AI vocabularies

How to do real-time editing

SabioCast provides an intuitive web interface that lets you read and modify the AI-generated captions in real time. It is designed for both first-time users and experienced editors, using a normal keyboard and mouse. Users can make corrections without any training, move text to other lines, or temporarily stop captions from appearing. Due to the high quality of our language models, only a limited number of corrections is needed.

01

Superior accuracy through real-time correction

It is significantly easier for a person to correct minor errors in high-quality subtitles than to create them from scratch.

02

Cost-effective, no matter how many languages

Enhanced AI requires only one or two correctors regardless of the number of languages, because the corrected captions are the source for every translated language.

03

Smart AI vocabularies

Vocabularies guarantee a correct rendition of names, brands, abbreviations and technical jargon, and relieve the workload of the real-time corrector.

Support & services

World-class support and services for global events

Premium support

SabioCast is a self-service platform. Use our AI solutions and hire correctors, interpreters or captioners yourself. Premium support adds a guaranteed response time, a service level and a custom Slack channel for direct contact with our engineers.

Managed service

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Speech-to-text is 99+% accurate for commonly used languages like English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch and Japanese. For less common languages accuracy is somewhat lower. Speaking speed and dialect only reduce accuracy in extreme cases, and accuracy improves further with human correction.

Unlimited. Our default AI multilingual plan includes 8 languages, but you can expand it to any number you want.

Yes. The ASR engine detects language changes and captions each segment in the language spoken, then translates everything into the caption languages you configured.

AI-powered captions add a delay of about one minute, slightly higher than normal HLS latency. This is necessary to improve accuracy and readability and to allow near real-time correction. Captions are always in sync with the video and audio.

Yes. All live captions are recorded in the cloud and can be downloaded as WebVTT files, or published as a Video on-Demand with captions hosted by SabioCast.

AI hours are used when captions or audio translations are generated by speech-to-text, text-to-text translation, or text-to-speech. Usage is counted per set of 8 AI languages per hour of broadcast, including time in 'preview' or 'paused' status.
